breakdown.description: The prompt ignores the contribution of the average normal stress to the in-plane shear state; the maximum in-plane shear depends on both σ_avg and τ_avg.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly includes both σ_avg and τ_avg in the maximum in-plane shear stress formula: τ_max = sqrt((σ_avg/2)^2 + τ_avg^2). It does not instruct the agent to use only the transverse shear stress alone, which was the error in the incomplete prompt. This matches the ground truth approach where both the normal stress and shear stress contribute to the in-plane shear state.
